dialogues.speaker: Hengting
dialogues.text: *sigh* I can't spend my whole life growing mass-market tea, can I...

dialogues.speaker: Hengting
dialogues.text: That stuff's often poured as the first cup for a customer who's just sat down. Hardly any difference between that and a cup of water.

dialogues.speaker: Hengting
dialogues.text: If that's all my effort amounts to, then what's the point?

dialogues.speaker: Aige
dialogues.text: Is it really that bad? Did your master say something again?

dialogues.speaker: Hengting
dialogues.text: Two days ago, he said I was good enough to strike out on my own. But I had a feeling that he meant I was a gone case.

dialogues.speaker: Hengting
dialogues.text: He didn't even look at me when he said those things.

dialogues.speaker: Aige
dialogues.text: Your master's always been strict with his students. He would never let someone sub-par go independent and ruin his reputation!

dialogues.speaker: Aige
dialogues.text: Maybe he didn't say anything because he thinks you're completely ready, which is why nothing more needs to be said.

dialogues.speaker: Aige
dialogues.text: And there's no hurry either, is there? You've been doing this for, what? Less than ten years? It would be unrealistic to expect to surpass the masters right away!

dialogues.speaker: Aige
dialogues.text: Given our age, it's normal to be far from being masters of our respective professions.

dialogues.speaker: Aige
dialogues.text: The tea baskets I weave look pretty ordinary, right? I think it's better that way. At least I'm not too stressed out about my job.

dialogues.speaker: Hengting
dialogues.text: I'm just glad you're not always tired. But I won't be satisfied with growing "ordinary" tea!

dialogues.speaker: Hengting
dialogues.text: I need to think of something to improve the quality.

dialogues.speaker: Aige
dialogues.text: How about our trip? Is that getting delayed again?

dialogues.speaker: Hengting
dialogues.text: Let's await the second harvest. If the quality improves, then we'll travel!

dialogues.speaker: Hengting
dialogues.text: Then we wait for another harvest, of course!
